dialogues.speaker: Qanafiya
dialogues.text: This evacuation was a huge operation. They needed a few people to stay behind and tie up loose ends, and I ended up being one of them. You're lucky you ran into us in time.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I certainly am. *sigh* I don't know how this happened. One thing led to another, and look how it ended up... I just hope our client doesn't get spooked and cancel their order.

dialogues.speaker: Qanafiya
dialogues.text: Fingers crossed. But either way, life goes on, and we all have to make a living somehow...
